question: How many gold medals did India win at the ISSF Junior World Cup 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is **6**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India won a total of **6 gold medals** at the ISSF Junior World Cup 2023.
 
• The event was held in **Suhl, Germany**.
 
• India's performance was among the best in the competition.
 
• The ISSF Junior World Cup is a prestigious event in the field of **shooting sports**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF)** is the governing body for the sport of shooting worldwide.
 
• The ISSF was founded in **1907** and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.
 
• The ISSF organizes various competitions, including the **World Championships** and the **World Cup** series.
 
• The ISSF Junior World Cup is specifically aimed at **younger athletes** to showcase their talents on an international stage.
